description: A download endpoint that resolves the requested name and rejects anything outside the upload directory. The safe version of path_traversal (false-positive check). Reviewer note: the diff shows no authentication on the endpoint. Whether that matters depends on the rest of the app, so a finding about it is a judgement call and counts as a false positive here.
